# Shift Production Schedule and Staffing Plan - Line 4
Target Date: 03/18/2026 | Shift: First (07:00 - 15:30)
Supervisor: Marcus Vance | Department: Beverage Packaging

## Production Targets
| SKU | Product Description | Target Cases | Line Speed (cpm) | Scheduled Run Time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BV-104 | 12 oz Sparkling Berry (24-pk) | 1,800 | 120 | 07:30 - 11:00 |
| BV-208 | 16 oz Citrus Tonic (12-pk) | 1,400 | 100 | 11:30 - 15:00 |

## Planned Sequence and Changeover
- 07:00 - 07:30: Pre-shift safety huddle, sanitized line pre-flight inspection, and material staging.
- 07:30 - 11:00: Production run for SKU BV-104.
- 11:00 - 11:30: Sanitization washdown and changeover to guide rails and capper tooling.
- 11:30 - 15:00: Production run for SKU BV-208.
- 15:00 - 15:30: End-of-shift washdown, scrap count, and handoff to second shift.

## Manning and Station Assignments
| Station | Primary Operator | Badge | Certified Backup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Depalletizer | Gregory Diaz | #4412 | Elena Rostova |
| Filler / Crowner | Elena Rostova | #3890 | Kevin Patel |
| Labeler & Coder | Kevin Patel | #5104 | Gregory Diaz |
| Case Packer | Sarah Chen | #2941 | Marcus Vance |

## Staging and Operational Notes
- Staging requirement: ensure 1,800 cases of 12 oz cans and 1,400 cases of 16 oz cans are staged at Depalletizer by 07:15.
- Labeler setup: Kevin Patel must verify date code stamp reads EXP 03/2027 and lot number.
- Relief operator rotation: assign Gregory Diaz to cover Filler during Elena Rostova scheduled 30-minute lunch break.
- Quality checks: pull 3 finished cases every 45 minutes for seal-integrity torque tests and fill-height checks.
